name: Sharp-NeRF
definition: A grid-based NeRF framework that renders clean and sharp images from input blurry images using discrete learnable kernels and a sharpness prior, achieving training times of approximately half an hour.
summary: Sharp-NeRF is a grid-based NeRF framework that renders sharp images from blurry inputs using discrete learnable kernels and a sharpness prior, enabling significantly faster training than MLP-based methods.
